name: dominodatalab
description: Domino Data Lab skills for Workspaces, Jobs, Compute Environments, Datasets, Projects, Apps, model endpoints and monitoring, MLflow experiment tracking, GenAI tracing, Flows, Spark/Ray/Dask clusters, governance, and the Domino APIs and SDKs

settings.name: Domino URL
settings.description: URL of your Domino deployment, used by the bundled Domino MCP server when it runs outside a Domino Workspace. Leave empty inside a Workspace.

settings.name: Domino token
settings.description: A Domino Personal Access Token or service account token, sent as a bearer by the bundled Domino MCP server when it runs outside a Domino Workspace. Leave empty inside a Workspace, where the server uses the API proxy.
